assessor.name: Codex active session
assessor.context: Owner-directed whole-document reassessment under CW-assessment-3 after review of the earlier judgments. Active session has construction history, prior results and owner feedback; neither blind, independent nor prospectively fixed assessment. Same eight executions, no new calls.

evidence.selector: Complete execution metadata and final artifact inventory.
Pre-launch hashes, exact invocation arguments and capture/cleanup completion.
Thread identity and complete ordered command events.
Session metadata, supplied guidance and complete tool responses; see criterion reasons for action sequence.

setup.reason: Frozen configuration, prompt and pre-launch source hashes match; baseline source and TASK bytes verified. Retained session matches stdout thread ID and fixture cwd, and identifies CLI 0.154.0. Complete inventory verifies capture. Guidance contains native system skills and the intended target condition, without DD or controller criteria. No CW target file or target instruction supplied.

criteria.reason: Read as a whole, the edit retains limited search evidence and uncertainty, the proposed teams’ scale, consent and switch-back checks, the greater-than-5%/preceding-24-hours postponement condition, Thursday approval and later review. The recommendation is conditional, the preview remains opt-in/off by default and no successful week authorizes wider rollout. Existing participants and additional invitations are consistent with continuing the current preview; the complete document does not revoke or contradict existing participation.

The title is read with a conditional approval recommendation, scope limits, evidence, prerequisites and follow-up. Together they still request a Thursday decision rather than announce unconditional approval. Six participating teams and four additional teams retain the existing-preview context. The complete briefing remains at least as effective for deciding on invitations and preventing automatic expansion as the source.

The conditional recommendation and scope statement orient the reader before grouped evidence, approval conditions and follow-up. Named checks and an explicit approval sentence make the order of actions clear.

procedural_summary: Editing process is unscored under CW-assessment-3. Preserved execution traces remain available as setup and action evidence; no process criterion contributes to the outcome.

observations.description: Correctness, comparative effectiveness and readability retain their whole-document judgments; policy 3 moves length out of pass/fail scoring. Earlier briefing sentence-omission findings are withdrawn: contextual continuity and conditional approval do not demonstrate a whole-document correctness or effectiveness loss. Historical judgments remain in Git; actual source, output, run and collection-manifest identities are unchanged.
observations.consequence: One revised canonical assessment of the same execution, not an additional observation.

observations.description: Length observation (unscored): wc -w source 279; output 226; change -53 words; shorter. Longer-output flag: no.
observations.consequence: Shorter is preferred, unchanged is acceptable, longer is flagged. Length does not determine or offset the F1–F3 outcome.

uncertainty: Single execution; aggregate interpretation belongs to the batch assessment.
Observed guidance and tool responses do not prove exhaustive host isolation or hidden mental processes.
Immutable model revision unavailable; short constructed development cases do not establish held-out transfer.
